title: Cone Jacobian: Gram-determinant scaling J(a, tw) = t^k J(a, w) and the bound J(a, w) ≤ ‖a‖ J(w)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, a ∈ ℝ^P (Euclid P) and w = (w_0, …, w_{k−1}) with every w_i ∈ ℝ^P. For a finite family v = (v_0, …, v_m) of vectors of ℝ^P let Γ(v) := det[⟨v_i, v_j⟩]_{i,j}, i.e. Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (v i) (v j)) (Γ of the empty family is 1), and let J(v) := √Γ(v), with Real.sqrt, which is 0 on negative numbers. Write (a, w) := Fin.cons a w = (a, w_0, …, w_{k−1}) (a family indexed by Fin (k+1)) and, for t ∈ ℝ, t·w := (t w_0, …, t w_{k−1}). Then: (i) J(a, t·w) = t^k·J(a, w) for every t ≥ 0; (ii) J(a, w) ≤ ‖a‖·J(w).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (w : Fin k → Euclid P), (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (k + 1) => inner ℝ ((Fin.cons a (t • w) : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) i) ((Fin.cons a (t • w) : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) j))) = t ^ k * Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (k + 1) => inner ℝ ((Fin.cons a w : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) i) ((Fin.cons a w : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) j)))) ∧ Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (k + 1) => inner ℝ ((Fin.cons a w : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) i) ((Fin.cons a w : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) j))) ≤ ‖a‖ * Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin k => inner ℝ (w i) (w j)))
